Hymn 330: See, the Mighty Angel Flying
Time Signature: 4/4
Musical Key: E-flat Major
Composer: Evan Stephens
Lyricist/Text Author: George Manwaring
Category: Special Topics

This is hymn number 330 titled "See, the Mighty Angel Flying" from the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints hymnbook. 
It is written in E-flat Major with a 4/4 time signature. 
The music was composed by Evan Stephens and the lyrics were written by George Manwaring.
This hymn is categorized under: Special Topics.
